saw_lines: Limited edition sneaker buyers want to see the shoe on a real foot and hear from people who already bought before they pre-order.
So a drop loses sales when the only thing a buyer sees is a product render and a 30 day pre-order window.
Your brand page shows one high top on a 30 day pre-order, so the first paid test should run real foot photos and the first buyer quotes to carry the drop.
ads_1: Paid test: the high top on a real foot, led by the MIDNIGHT TRAP name and made in Italy.
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and Youtube
